content.text: Matt Fitzpatrick and Scottie Scheffler head into the final round of the 2026 RBC Heritage tournament with the top two scores. The final round of the 2026 RBC Heritage opens with Scottie Scheffler hot on the heels of the leader after a strong third round. Scheffler shot a seven-under 64 to move up to second place after two modest rounds on the Harbour Town Golf Links in South Carolina. He is 14-under-par, three strokes behind the leader. Matt Fitzpatrick picked up the lead in the second round and has not relinquished. Heading into the final round, Fitzpatrick is 17-under-par with rounds of 65, 63, and 68. Behind those two is a trio at 13-under-par overall in Brian Harman, Si Woo Kim, and Sepp Straka. Scheffler was on top of his game in the third round. He finished with eight birdies in the third round and just one bogey. In the first two rounds, Scheffler finished with nine total birdies and two bogeys. Now Scheffler is in a position to win his second tournament of the year. Through the first three rounds, Fiztpatrick has 20 birdies, three bogeys and one eagle to help build his lead. The eagle came on the 15th hole in the third round to help keep separation from the rest of the field. FedEx Cup points leader Cameron Young is just eight-under-par heading into the final round. He climbed back up the leaderboard after opening with an even par 71 to start the tournament. Since then, Young has had back-to-back rounds of four-under-par.
